0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Philadelphia 76ers visit the New York Knicks. The 76ers will be without Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, hip), and Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring), and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 144-114 loss in Philadelphia on May 10.
